messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Contact and Conversation" as it appears in the following examples.
['If this proposal is acceptable by you, please endeavor to contact me immediately.', 'I await your soonest response through here if you can consider my plight and help me out.', 'I would want you to send me your full names your phone number and your mailing address to enable me talk to you before I send you the certificate of deposit.', 'If you are honest, trustworthy and interested in the above proposal, contact me immediately through my email address for more details.', 'Please direct your reply to my confidential email:blog333ng@mail.AZ or through the below fax.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "I urge you to contact me promptly by email, fax, or phone, share your details, and respond to discuss the proposal."}
